summary: So I've been checking in with people about this movie, and it seems like some things are really working well. A lot of people seem to really enjoy how it looks – the visuals keep coming up. Some folks are also loving the music – it's like it adds to the whole experience. And as for the feel, yeah, it's definitely there – people are saying it's like a big, exciting event. It's also interesting to see who's really connecting with this movie. From what I've gathered, it seems to be resonating most with families or parents with kids. They're enjoying the way it's made, and it's clear that it's been thought about with their little ones in mind. Now, I know some people might have some reservations about this movie – it's not for everyone, after all. But from what I've seen, the majority of people are really enjoying it.
